svg.text: same rooms · water heater out of the kitchen → tankless in the shed · floor furnace out → mini-splits · laundry stays in the shed
Sept 12, 2026 · Keith's sketch scaled to the measured rooms [M]; the rest estimated
walls 6″ exterior / 5″ interior · doors 2′-8″ (bath 2′-6″, closets 2′-0″ [M]) · front door 3′-0″ · slider 5′-5″ [M]
W/D · tankless WH · east door only
measured · slider · closet door on east wall
Same plan as existing — no rooms move and no walls change. Kitchen stays where it is.
Water heater leaves the kitchen: a tankless unit goes on the wall in the laundry / shed (gas + vent + cold/hot lines run from there), and the freed
corner by the range becomes counter. Washer and dryer stay in the shed; it keeps its outside-only east door.
Floor furnace (red-tagged) comes out; the hall floor is patched. Heat by ductless mini-splits: heads marked MS in the living room and both bedrooms,
outdoor unit on the east side by the shed.
Not shown: 200 A panel and rewire, EV charger, driveway, finishes. Bearing: nothing is removed on the partition.
